title: Refutation engines, Appendix D encodings, BMC over the extracted TRANS edges, concretization, emitted tests and the final finding filter

predictions.claim: SMT re-finds every existing REFUTED witness class: the 26 classes of spec/M3/lib/refute.json (one per REFUTED record of results/{M0,M1,M2,M2/extracted_m1,M3} at the prereg, one per checked entry point of a per-entry record: C01 M0/L_dom_hdr domain, C02 L_par_hdr_ssvh codec (bytes 185-216), C03 L_par_hdr_v2 codec (byte 0), C04-C11 the eight M1 trace classes, C12-C14 the :363 site law at commitBatch, commitBatchWithProof, commitState, C15 the :636 site law at finalizeBatch, C16-C22 the seven view records of results/M2/extracted_m1, C23-C25 the three M3 cross-component codec laws (bytes 185-216), C26 the M3 domain law). For each, the template query over the law's own model (the witness's keys and action skeleton fixed, everything else free; the differing positions required for a codec class; the version byte and the two verdicts for a domain class) is sat within the rlimit of 200000000, and the first candidate's counter-law gen/M3/refute/refind/<id>/PROOF.bend (importing the record's model and LAWS.bend, defining Laws.<law_name>) is accepted by Bend and BendTT with the class's signature.

On the 88 codec laws (M0's 8 over facts/morph_header.json and the 80 M3 PAR laws over gen/M3/codec/header_length.json) the solver's verdict on each negation is the one its status implies: sat with an accepted candidate on exactly the 7 REFUTED laws (M0 L_dom_hdr, L_par_hdr_ssvh, L_par_hdr_v2; M3 L_par_cc_BatchCache_createBatchHeaderWithSequencerSetHash_enc_sol_v2, L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV0_Bytes_enc_sol_v0, L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_enc_sol_v1, L_par_dom_BatchHeaderBytes_validate_ok_load_sol), unsat on the 78 PROVED laws and on the 3 PAR-weak UNKNOWN laws (byte strings up to 512 bytes); no query ends unknown.

Every solver, fuzzer and BMC candidate either passes its counter-law on the law's compiled model (Bend and BendTT accept it) or is discarded with the checker's output, and none is dropped silently; on the 26 class templates no candidate is discarded (each first candidate passes): the Appendix D encodings (E1-E7 with ground NZ) agree with the compiled models on every shape that has a refutation.

I15's two UNKNOWN site laws stay UNKNOWN. L_sort_site_def_lci_356891e4 ((lfi + len(win)) - 1 needs lfi + len(win) >= 1; the hand model's window always holds the entry at LFI) and L_sort_site_l1messagequeuewithgaspriceoracle_325_f89daf17 (btot - bn; a committed header's total is its parent's plus its own count): SMT unrolled to 8 steps of their instrumented model (gen/M2/model/morph_rollup.bend) from s0 is unsat with no candidate (bound {steps: 8}, budget rlimit 200000000 per query), fuzz (seed 20261014, 4096 candidates) finds no candidate; their records do not change beyond generator_sha256 and timing.

I20's two UNKNOWN width laws stay UNKNOWN. L_sort_width_batchheadercodecv0_144_1abeb29c (batchIndex at BatchHeaderCodecV0.sol:144) and L_sort_width_batchheadercodecv0_166_8ad80b42 (totalL1MessagePopped at :166): BMC over the TRANS edges of spec/M2/facts/morph_rollup.extracted.json from the binding's deployment shows no path to a stored value >= 2^64 within H = 8 (no_path, largest_k 8, budget rlimit 200000000 per query): within 8 steps the stored batchIndex is at most 8 and totalL1MessagePopped stays 0 under the deployment's empty queue; their records do not change.

I24's three UNKNOWN PAR-weak laws stay UNKNOWN (L_par_weak_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobCommitHash_BatchHeaderBytes_BlobHashesHash_v2, ..._BlobVersionedHash_v0, ..._BlobVersionedHash_v1): SMT on each negation is unsat (BlobCommitHash dispatches by version to exactly BlobHashesHash at >= 2 and BlobVersionedHash below, common/batch/batch_header.go:138-148, so under the tag premise both sides are one function), fuzz accepts none, and no I40 engine proves a byte-string law (I24 gap G6 stays).

Every record's bin is recomputed (final filter F1-F4 over concretization K1-K4): of the 24 REFUTED records at the prereg (13 finding, 11 pending before), 16 are finding (M0 L_par_hdr_ssvh, L_par_hdr_v2 and the three M3 L_par_cc laws by commit class; M1 L_sort_remaining, L_sym_omega, L_tag_BVH, L_undo_BVH, L_undo_cancel, M2 L_sort_site_rollup_363_1fc7f88a and _636_e68daf06, and the view's L_sort_remaining, L_sym_omega, L_undo_BVH, L_undo_cancel directly), 4 known_limitation with BMC no_path within H = 8 (M0 L_dom_hdr and M3 L_par_dom_BatchHeaderBytes_validate_ok_load_sol: target dom_v0_long, no successful public step loads a version-0 header longer than 249 bytes, every load being authenticated against committedBatches; M1 and view L_nat_eta2: target eta2_state, committedStateRoots[0] is never zero while batch 1 is unfinalized), 1 model_defect (the view's L_disch_delay_nofree: its emitted test fails, the last commitBatch(n=1) that the view accepts reverting on the real Rollup), 3 pending (M1 and view L_fact_Z: the go_consumer side does not observe the obstruction, ParseBatch rejecting both sidecars; M1 L_own_txspayload: go_only, a node-level public path needs I39).

Deep reaches: of the 120 guard reaches I20's step refinement left unfalsified (results/M2/refinement/extracted.json), BMC over the extracted TRANS edges from R0 falsifies these 8 with shortest paths that replay on the real Rollup (every step but the last ok, the last reverting with the reach's reason, external-call answers agreeing): the six 'pending revert request' reaches Rollup.sol:132#0 of challengeState, commitBatch, commitBatchWithProof, commitState, finalizeBatch and proveState, each in 4 steps (a commit, a challenge, a proveState after the proof window whose timeout branch sets revertReqIndex, then the action), and the reinitializer reaches Initializable.sol:120#0 of initialize2 and initialize3, each in 2 steps; and shows no path within H = 8 to 22: initialize's four Initializable.sol:133 and initialize2's Rollup.sol:189 constant-condition reaches, initialize's Rollup.sol:169 and :171, initialize4's Initializable.sol:120 and Rollup.sol:211-214, and importGenesisBatch's ten reaches after :228 (Rollup.sol:825, :826, :844, :233, :235, :237, :238, :239, BatchHeaderCodecV0.sol:32, BatchHeaderCodecV1.sol:35).

Sensitivity on the planted fixture (tests_m3/fixtures/refute/, test milestones T401 and T402): the realize law L_sort_realize_toylock_53_941d10c2 of variant a (W + start - block.timestamp at src/ToyLock.sol:53, whose only counterexample is the seven-step chain arm, s1, s2, s3, s4, s5, fire with fire after arm) is UNKNOWN with no witness under the current refuter (I30's S1-S3 with the rollup's budget: at most 4-step traces, S3 needs another entry point) and is REFUTED by BMC (H = 8) with exactly that 7-step witness, its counter-law accepted by Bend and BendTT, its emitted test and holon's replay passing, and the independent replay on the real toy giving six ok steps and Panic 0x11; variant b (require(W + start >= block.timestamp) on line 52) is not REFUTED and BMC returns no_path with largest_k 8.

I21's open findings, split: T2's EVM half (a public commit at version 0 or 1 carrying no blob, which stores ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH) has a 1-step path from R0 that replays on the real Rollup (one ok step after which batchBlobVersionedHashes[1] is ZERO_VERSIONED_HASH, external calls agreeing); T1's EVM half (a successful public step loading a 281-byte version-0 header) and F-M2-42 (a version-2 commit whose blob-hash vector holds a zero before a non-zero entry, excluded by E3's dense prefix) have no path within H = 8 (no_path, largest_k 8); T1's and T2's Go halves are out_of_scope (T1's node-side reachability, the derivation stopping at the 2954 281-byte-parent commits, needs I39's Go derivation and product machine, which does not exist; T2's ParseBatch is I38/I39), and F-M2-38, F-M2-39, F-M2-40, F-M2-41 are out_of_scope with the sidecar's reasons.

The emitted tests (holon/gen/foundry.py, holon/gen/gotest.py) replace the hand op tables: for each of the 16 public_schedule and library_api sides of the 13 records with I4 replay entries (M0 3, M1 8, M2 2), the emitted test's side has the hand harness's status and obstruction_observed.

regressions.claim: Gates M0, M1 and M2 pass (G6 recomputing every REFUTED record's bin with the final rule); every M0-M2 record keeps its status, statement hash and witness; no PROVED record changes status.

Every M0-M2 record file at the prereg differs at HEAD only in filter_bin, concretization, generator_sha256 and keys named seconds; no commit that writes an I40 outcome path changes laws/M0-M2, gen/M0-M2, replay/M0-M2, spec/M1/, spec/M2/facts/, spec/M2/lib/, gen/M3/sorts/, a frozen root or an I40 instrument (spec/M3/lib/refute.json, spec/M3/lib/sort_types.json, spec/M3/predictions.json, prompts/I40_refute.md, tests_m3/test_refute.py, tests_m3/_i40.py, tests_m3/fixtures/refute/), and every result record file of results/{M0,M1,M2,M2/extracted_m1,M3} such a commit changes differs from its parent's version only in those fields, none added or deleted (checked from git).

holon.filter.bin_of stays I4's provisional rule (tests_m2/_i4.py::expected_bin); holon.filter.final_bin agrees with tests_m3/_i40.py::expected_final_bin on every small input; the only amendments are the two expected I4 lines (tests_m2/test_filter.py::TestBins::test_records_follow_the_rule and ::test_bins_of_recorded_replays).

Construction checks, not counted: the sidecar's computed fields are sidecar_doc on the prereg tree; the solver pin is the installed z3 4.16.0; the toys re-extract byte for byte; the hand-built toy chains and rollup paths behave on the real code as the instruments expect (run at the prereg); every query is ground and states its instances; layout queries exist; BMC's queries state E5's time and E7's cost instances; config/holon.json pins the solver; filter.json lists every recomputed bin; every BMC path obeys the sidecar's environment (principals, time, blob hashes, value, H); the encoder's instance counts; every REFUTED record at HEAD has a concretization and the final bin; the manifest; every reach has a verdict; records valid under v1 and v2 with the schema's known_limitation; emitted tests regenerate byte for byte; holon refute --check reproduces every output; no target identifier in the engines; the full M3 gate passes (it fails at the prereg: its G6 finds no target commit in the linked codec document and its G4 no canary over the linked model; I30's gate wiring and I40's G6 make it pass).
